title: Schrodinger Bridges Beat Diffusion Models on Text-to-Speech Synthesis
tldr_zh: 用文本潜变量替换高斯先验，配对数据上完全可解 SB，2-4 步合成超 Grad-TTS 与快速 TTS 基线
tldr_en: Replaces Gaussian prior with text latent in a fully tractable paired-data Schrodinger bridge; 2-4 step TTS beats Grad-TTS and fast baselines
key_numbers: Ablation: mutable prior CMOS -0.13 (NFE=4) / -0.17 (NFE=1000); constant g(t) -0.12 / -0.14; ODE -0.10 / +0.00 (Table 4)
Training: 1.7M iterations, batch size 16, single RTX 3090, 2.5 days (Sec. 4.1)

relations.type: 同属配对数据可解 SB 家族，本文指出其设计空间分析不足
同期 FM 路线，本文在少步 TTS 上与之竞争
